message.content:
A cell that contains more than one nucleus is called a **multinucleated cell**.  
In biology this condition is often referred to as a **syncytium**—a single cell membrane encompassing many nuclei. Examples include:

| Cell type | Typical function | Example |
|-----------|------------------|---------|
| Skeletal muscle fiber | Contractile activity | Myocyte |
| Osteoclast | Bone resorption | Multinucleated giant cell |
| Certain immune cells | Phagocytosis / antigen presentation | Giant cell granuloma |

So if you’re looking for a general term, “multinucleated” or “syncytium” describes such cells.
